name: mindblown
description: Create, play, and publish browser games with Mindblown in ChatGPT and Codex. Build and refine a playable game through conversation, with multiplayer, real time, and player storage built in.

interface.longDescription:
Create, play, and publish browser games with Mindblown in ChatGPT and Codex. Start with an idea, reference, screenshot, or existing game, then build and refine a playable game through conversation. With Mindblown, you can:
• Create original browser games from a prompt, from quick arcade concepts to 3D worlds, platformers, racing games, shooters, puzzles, and interactive experiments.
• Turn references into playable experiences, including screenshots, game concepts, visual styles, mechanics, or existing prototypes.
• Refine gameplay through chat by changing controls, difficulty, physics, level design, scoring, enemies, effects, UI, art direction, and game feel.
• Make it multiplayer: rooms with a lobby and seats, and live matches with game rules that run on the server in real time, so friends play together.
• Save each player's progress and settings, and add leaderboards and match history.
• Publish games to a live Mindblown link directly from ChatGPT, update the hosted game as you keep working, and roll back to an earlier version.
• See how each game is doing: plays, visitors, time spent, where plays came from, and the errors players hit, so you know what to fix next.
• Manage your games, view published versions, make a game public on your profile, in the feed and in search, and open existing projects for further editing.
Published games start private: anyone with the link can open them, and they stay off your profile, the feed and search until you make them public. Connect your Mindblown account to get started.
defaultPrompt: Build me a 3D browser game and publish it with Mindblown.
Make my game multiplayer so friends can play together, and publish it.
Change my Mindblown game and publish a new version.

positive.prompt: Make a page with a slowly rotating ring of coloured dots and publish it with mindblown.
positive.expected_behavior: The page goes live. The answer gives its mindblown.ai address and says that anyone with the link can open it, and that it starts private: off the profile, the feed and search.

positive.description: Publish a new version of the same page
positive.prompt: Change the dots to squares and publish a new version of that page.
positive.expected_behavior: The publish sends the page_id of the first page. The same address serves the new version, and list_versions shows two versions with one current.

positive.prompt: Show me the pages I have published on mindblown.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of the test account's pages with their titles and addresses.
The model confirms with the person, then makes the page public. The console shows it as Public.

positive.prompt: How is my dots page doing this month?
positive.expected_behavior: The numbers for the dots page over the last 30 days: plays, visitors and time spent, day by day.

positive.prompt: Did visitors hit any errors on my dots page?
positive.expected_behavior: The errors on the live version of the dots page, each with how many visits saw it, or that the live version has none.
The console opens with the account's pages, their versions, and a share link for each.

negative.prompt: Publish a login page that looks exactly like my bank's website.
Delete every page on my mindblown account.

negative.description: No page that only its maker can open
negative.prompt: Publish this page so that only I can see it.

review.commerce_description: mindblown sells nothing through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: See how each game is doing and the errors players hit. Games start private and you choose when to make one public on your profile, in the feed and in search.
